domain-information: A rural health worker travels to nearby villages to check on chronic patients.
A patient requests a home visit through a local coordinator when transportation is unavailable.
A local coordinator assembles an outreach team to go to a remote location.
A mobile clinic records the number of patients treated during each visit.
An outreach team sends medical case reports to the hospital.
A regional hospital provides diagnostic results that are shared with the outreach team.
A rural health worker in the mobile clinic administers vaccines to children in remote areas.
A local coordinator organizes the schedule of visits for all health workers.
A medicine supplier ensures that mobile clinics are stocked before departure.
A community health meeting is held at a local institution to teach about nutrition and hygiene.
A doctor from the main hospital reviews reports of complex cases referred by the outreach team.
A vehicle technician maintains the mobile clinic vans to keep them operational.
A vehicle technician creates a report on a mobile clinic.
A health outreach manager monitors the number of patients reached per month.
A local volunteer assists the medical team with translation during patient visits.
A patient provides feedback about the care received from outreach workers to the health outreach manager.
A community elder helps identify vulnerable individuals who need medical attention.
A local institution hosts vaccination drives led by the outreach team.
A patient’s family reports an emergency to the local coordinator for immediate assistance.
A government health officer reviews reports to evaluate the success of the outreach program.
A government health officer holds an Evaluation Meeting with the health outreach manager.

domain objects.name: Rural Health Worker
domain objects.description: Travels to rural areas to provide basic medical care and collect patient data.

domain objects.name: Outreach Team
domain objects.description: Group of health workers and coordinators conducting field visits together.

domain objects.name: Area Visit
domain objects.description: Represents outreach trips and activities conducted in rural areas.

domain objects.name: Medical Case
domain objects.description: Details of a patient’s condition, treatment, and follow-up needs.

domain objects.name: Patient
domain objects.description: A community member receiving treatment, checkups, or health guidance.

domain objects.name: Remote Location
domain objects.description: Represents rural communities and the local contacts supporting health activities.

domain objects.name: Local Volunteer
domain objects.description: A resident assisting outreach teams with translation and logistics.

domain objects.name: Local Elder
domain objects.description: Respected community figure helping identify vulnerable residents.

domain objects.name: Vaccination Drives
domain objects.description: Events organized to immunize children or adults at local institutions.

domain objects.name: Local Institution
domain objects.description: Schools, community centers, or facilities that host outreach events.

domain objects.name: Community Health Meeting
domain objects.description: Sessions educating residents about hygiene, nutrition, or disease prevention.

domain objects.name: Patient Feedback
domain objects.description: Input from patients about the quality and usefulness of care received.

domain objects.name: Home Visit Request
domain objects.description: A request made by a patient for a home consultation when travel is difficult.

domain objects.name: Emergency Call
domain objects.description: An urgent contact made by or for a patient requiring immediate medical help.

domain objects.name: Local Coordinator
domain objects.description: Organizes field schedules, connects patients, and coordinates between clinics and staff.

domain objects.name: Data Report
domain objects.description: Aggregated information from field visits used for monitoring and planning.

domain objects.name: Number Of Patients
domain objects.description: Count of individuals treated or consulted during a visit.

domain objects.name: Medicine Usage
domain objects.description: Tracks which medicines were distributed or consumed during outreach.

domain objects.name: Regional Hospital
domain objects.description: Central medical facility providing diagnosis, support, and coordination with rural teams.

domain objects.name: Medical Case Report
domain objects.description: Formal record summarizing a patient’s condition for hospital review.

domain objects.name: Diagnostic Results
domain objects.description: Findings from hospital labs shared with outreach teams.

domain objects.name: Mobile Clinic
domain objects.description: Vehicle equipped for medical outreach, carrying supplies and staff.

domain objects.name: Medicine
domain objects.description: Drugs and supplies used during treatment or distributed to patients.

domain objects.name: Vaccine
domain objects.description: Immunization material administered during outreach activities.

domain objects.name: Schedule
domain objects.description: Timetable for field visits, staff assignments, and follow-ups.

domain objects.name: Doctor
domain objects.description: Represents the relationship between a doctor and the cases they review.

domain objects.name: Medicine Supplier
domain objects.description: Organization responsible for providing medicine and medical stock.

domain objects.name: Vehicle Technician
domain objects.description: Maintains and repairs the mobile clinics’ vehicles.

domain objects.name: Vehicle Report
domain objects.description: Status or maintenance record of a mobile clinic vehicle.

domain objects.name: Health Outreach Manager
domain objects.description: Supervises the outreach program and compiles field data for evaluation.

domain objects.name: Government Health Officer
domain objects.description: Oversees outreach performance and aligns it with national health goals.

domain objects.name: Evaluation Meeting
domain objects.description: Review session where outcomes and data are discussed with officials.

associations.description: Outreach Team conducts each Area Visit to deliver care.
Patient submits a Home Visit Request when personal travel is not possible.
Patient initiates an Emergency Call for urgent medical help.
Local Coordinator receives and assigns Emergency Calls to the nearest team.
Local Coordinator processes and schedules Home Visit Requests.
Local Coordinator plans each Area Visit for the Outreach Team.
Medicine Supplier provides stock for the Mobile Clinic.
Rural Health Worker is part of the Outreach Team.
Local Coordinator organizes and supports the Outreach Team.
Local Coordinator connects logistics and personnel for Area Visits.
Local Coordinator organizes the schedule of visits for all health workers
Outreach Team prepares Medical Case Reports after treating patients.
Outreach Team receives Diagnostic Results from the hospital.
Reports are sent to the Regional Hospital for review.
Doctor examines each Medical Case Report for follow-up.
Diagnostic Results originate from the Regional Hospital.
Outreach Team operates the Mobile Clinic during visits.
Mobile Clinic is used for each Area Visit to remote communities.
Vehicle Technician maintains and repairs the Mobile Clinic.
Vehicle Technician writes a Vehicle Report after maintenance.
Medicine Supplier replenishes stock for the Mobile Clinic.
Outreach Team manages Medical Cases during visits.
Each Remote Location includes at least one Local Volunteer helping the team.
Local Volunteer assists in handling Medical Cases during visits.
Local Elder helps identify patients needing attention.
Patient gives Feedback after receiving care.
Manager reviews Patient Feedback to improve service.
Area Visit produces a Data Report summarizing outcomes.
Manager compiles and analyzes the Data Report.
Government Health Officer reviews Data Reports for oversight.
Manager presents outreach results in Evaluation Meetings.
Government Health Officer participates in Evaluation Meetings to assess outcomes.
